benchmarks.methodology: Benchmarks are grouped by state/Western, category, exact price unit, source series, Corriente origin, reporting period, and weight cohort. Auction weighted-average types may be combined only in the explicit auction_weighted_average series. Video, direct trade, ranges, and state summaries remain separate. Head weighting is used only when every observation has a positive head count; otherwise all observations contribute equally.

methodology: Auction prices, USDA state summaries, direct trades, video contracts and published price bands are retained as separate record types. They are not pooled into one price series.
